card.name: The word direct or directly
card.fires_on: The word "direct" or "directly" meaning without intermediate steps, often right after a verb like go or injected, or before a noun like link or effect.

modes.label: Directly after a verb
modes.description: "directly" follows a verb of movement or delivery and is followed by "to" or "into".

modes.label: Direct before a noun
modes.description: "direct" modifies a noun such as link, route or effect.
modes.example: Adenosine injection exerts a<< direct>> depressant effect on the SA and AV

modes.label: Direct in capitals
modes.description: The capitalised label phrase "DIRECT INTRAVENOUS" in a warning, firing on the end of the following word.
